presets.name: uefi-ext4
presets.summary: ESP + a single writable ext4 root; the layout every ReproOS image has shipped with

presets.name: uefi-attested
presets.summary: ESP + two integrity-checked read-only root slots + separate /var, /home and swap; the shape an attestable image needs
presets.unbuildableReason: boot goes through a unified kernel image whose command line pins the root hash inside the measured binary, and this layout now carries both root slots and both hash-tree volumes that command line names, but the image driver still does not write the integrity-checked root image or its hash tree onto them; the result would be a measured command line naming volumes that exist and are empty
